tools.name: search_kb
tools.description: Search a unified, ranked pool of Legacy, N001 and Native Core candidates for DST engineering. Deliver only whole original atoms admitted for this task and its positive/negative scope. Named samples require their own bounded original evidence and task relation under a fixed source version; relevance of the containing record alone is insufficient. Use projection=reviewer and view=decision for existing-code review or Native API research, then expand only useful IDs. Ranking explains relevance; it does not grant Coding admission or prove evidence. projection controls admission independently from view. Coding hold/prohibited remain excluded in every mode and view. scope_logic=and intersects filter dimensions; or unions them. Not for gameplay advice.

tools.name: lookup_api
tools.description: Navigate an exact declaration identity to mapped preserved typed claims; contract_delivery separates actual claim delivery, partial delivery and identity-only navigation. Use source_file to select the exact original scripts/...lua path when accepted physical declarations are ambiguous. Repeated records of one physical declaration do not create ambiguity. File-local declarations remain file-local. A catalog scope gap never establishes that the API is absent. Same-name methods of different owners do not substitute. Exact symbols alone are not method contracts. Defaults to projection=reviewer and compact view=decision; exact lookup is research navigation, not a Coding default or admission promotion. Inspect scope, corrections and current vanilla source; expand a selected ID only as needed.

source_file.description: Optional exact original scripts/...lua path. Required when accepted same-name declarations belong to different sources; does not promote file-local declarations to public APIs.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Read one canonical knowledge ID. Omitting view preserves the legacy call shape; explicit view=decision is compact, reviewer adds research detail, evidence exposes evidence navigation. projection separately controls admission: selecting a view never bypasses Coding HOLD. For research use projection=reviewer, then resolve one exact evidence reference if necessary.

tools.name: get_context_bundle
tools.description: Start a substantial DST engineering task with a bounded selection from the unified ranked pool. For existing-code review or Native API research choose projection=reviewer, view=decision and normally budget=normal. Pack complete original atoms with their necessary original Scope and evidence metadata under the unchanged total payload budget. Never cut a branch or rewrite a fact to fit; withheld atoms and unresolved Scope or evidence remain explicit gaps. Named samples are bounded references only when their own original evidence and task relation qualify. Inspect gaps and progressively expand selected IDs. metadata_ref and metadata_template resolve within that card shared_metadata table. mode changes task priorities, never admission. Coding keeps its existing admitted defaults and hold/prohibited exclusions.
